가게와의 대화 | 2,123 (주문당 1곳 544건, 5~6곳 177건)

candidates.rule: The kit did not pay 360 of 1,058 food receipts (34%); 343 of those receipts were rejected for insufficient shelf life.

candidates.rule: Shop conversations take one to two seconds; sequential searching lost about 4.6 seconds on roughly one fifth of successful orders, while the market issues the next order about 20 seconds after an order ends, measured on 11/4 at 10:4x.
candidates.quote: 시장은 주문이 끝나고 약 20초 뒤 다음 주문을 준다(11/4 10:4x 측정).

candidates.rule: The analysis attributed most of the difference between 34% ledger success and lee-sungsoo's 62% to food orders that agreed on price but failed at payment.
candidates.quote: 이것이 장부 성사율 34%와 lee-sungsoo 62% 차이의 대부분이다.
candidates.harness: Prioritize identifying food deals likely to fail payment before optimizing search speed.

candidates.rule: Food grades are based on remaining shelf-life proportion: A is at least 80%, B is at least 45% and below 80%, and C is below 45%.
candidates.quote: 식품 등급은 남은 유통기한 비율로 정해진다(A 80% 이상, B 45% 이상, C 그 아래
candidates.harness: Use these thresholds when interpreting a food grade claim.

candidates.rule: A food grade claim and the SKU's shelf_hours give a range, not an exact remaining shelf life: A maps to 0.8–1.0 times shelf_hours, B to 0.45–0.8 times shelf_hours, and C to 0–0.45 times shelf_hours.
candidates.harness: Compare the order's use period with the claim-derived range, preserving uncertainty where the range overlaps.
candidates.loc: design/buyer-parallel.md lines 1-133 (buyer 병렬 탐색과 유통기한 사전 확인: 설계와 적용 가능성 (2026-11-04 21:0x, 초안))

candidates.rule: Among approximately 750 matched payment records, C claims whose use period exceeded 45% of shelf_hours were rejected for shelf life 138 times and paid 8 times; this was described as a 95% rejection rate.
candidates.quote: C | 주문 사용 기간 > 유통기한 45% (확실히 부족) | 8 | **138**
candidates.harness: Treat this clearly insufficient C-claim case as a strong rejection signal, not an absolute guarantee.
candidates.loc: design/buyer-parallel.md lines 1-133 (buyer 병렬 탐색과 유통기한 사전 확인: 설계와 적용 가능성 (2026-11-04 21:0x, 초안))

candidates.rule: In the same approximately 750-record analysis, B claims with use periods between 45% and 80% of shelf_hours had 65 payments and 84 shelf-life rejections; C claims in the uncertain 0–45% range had 149 payments and no shelf-life rejections.
candidates.harness: Do not reject receipts merely because their shelf-life estimate is in an uncertain range.

candidates.rule: For A or B claims whose use period was at or below the lower bound, 270 payments and 25 shelf-life rejections were observed; the 25 were identified as false A claims.
candidates.quote: A, B | 사용 기간 ≤ 하한 (확실히 충분) | 270 | 25 (A 주장이 거짓)
candidates.harness: Allow shop-specific evidence of false grade claims to affect future expected value.

candidates.rule: The receipt does not contain the certificate body; the buyer can see the shop's claimed grade and grades mentioned in the conversation, while the kit receives the certificate during ACP payment after the buyer has finished.
candidates.quote: 영수증은 인증서 본문을 담지 않는다(인증서는 buyer가 끝난 뒤 키트가 ACP 결제에서 받음).
candidates.harness: Make the pre-payment shelf check using only grade information actually available to the buyer.

candidates.rule: The proposed shelf guard checks receipt.claim before finishing; when a receipt is judged clearly insufficient, the buyer returns no receipt, records a no-deal finish, and tries the next shop.
candidates.quote: `receipt.claim`으로 같은 검사. 걸리면 영수증을 돌려주지 않고 `finish_none("no deal: shelf ...")`, `run()`의 다음 가게 루프가 이어서 시도한다
candidates.harness: Reject only qualifying receipts before finalization and continue to the next shop.

candidates.rule: The proposed shelf guard leaves uncertain B-range receipts alone and records shop-specific shelf-life rejections so future expected-value selection can penalize that shop, including for false A claims.
candidates.quote: 불확실(B 45~80%) 구간은 건드리지 않는다
candidates.harness: Preserve uncertain deals, but use recorded shop outcomes to reduce expected value for shops with shelf-life rejections.

candidates.rule: On 11/4 at 01:47, stating a required minimum shelf life in the first message caused shops to reject: 44 of 118 conversations reached agreement, and only 2 of 26 later orders succeeded.
candidates.quote: 첫 메시지에 "N시간 이상 남은 것"을 적어 가게가 첫 메시지에서 거절했다 (118건 중 44건 합의 → 26건 중 2건).
candidates.harness: Do not disclose the buyer's required shelf time to shops as part of the proposed shelf guard.

candidates.rule: The proposed receipt-only screen would filter 146 receipts, of which 8 would otherwise have been paid; the estimate was about 1% of roughly 700 food payments per six hours.
candidates.quote: 거르는 146건 중 원래 결제되던 것은 8건(6 h에 식품 결제 약 700건의 1%)이다.
candidates.harness: Track lost valid payments as well as avoided rejections when evaluating the guard.

candidates.rule: The proposed parallel design probes the first messages to the top K shops concurrently without sending prices; negotiation and price offers then proceed with only one shop at a time.
candidates.quote: 핵심은 **병렬은 첫 메시지 왕복만**이라는 점이다.
candidates.harness: Parallelize only initial shop contact; keep negotiation sequential.

candidates.rule: After the initial replies, rank live conversations that pass the shelf check by lowest asking or listed price, then expected value; negotiate in that order, moving to the next conversation after failure and then searching remaining shops sequentially within the time budget.
candidates.quote: 호가/정가 낮은 순 → expected 순으로 정렬
candidates.harness: Apply this ordering and fallback sequence when the parallel probe is enabled.
candidates.loc: design/buyer-parallel.md lines 1-133 (buyer 병렬 탐색과 유통기한 사전 확인: 설계와 적용 가능성 (2026-11-04 21:0x, 초안))

candidates.rule: A shop issues a receipt when it accepts the buyer's price offer, so a price-free first-message probe cannot produce an agreed receipt; a receipt sent before any buyer offer is not agreement and must not be paid.
candidates.quote: 우리 제안 전의 영수증은 합의가 아님, 결제 안 함
candidates.harness: Do not treat or pay a receipt that arrives before the buyer has made an offer.
candidates.loc: design/buyer-parallel.md lines 1-133 (buyer 병렬 탐색과 유통기한 사전 확인: 설계와 적용 가능성 (2026-11-04 21:0x, 초안))

candidates.rule: Only one conversation may receive a price offer at a time, preventing two shops from accepting offers simultaneously; the buyer's result must contain at most one receipt.
candidates.quote: 가격이 담긴 메시지는 한 번에 한 대화에서만 나간다
candidates.harness: Serialize all price offers and enforce a single-receipt result.
candidates.loc: design/buyer-parallel.md lines 1-133 (buyer 병렬 탐색과 유통기한 사전 확인: 설계와 적용 가능성 (2026-11-04 21:0x, 초안))

candidates.rule: At the end of a parallel search, cancel every open conversation other than the successful one; shops experience this like the buyer leaving after a conversation.
candidates.quote: 끝날 때 열린 대화는 모두 취소한다.
candidates.harness: Cancel all remaining open shop conversations before finishing the order.
candidates.loc: design/buyer-parallel.md lines 1-133 (buyer 병렬 탐색과 유통기한 사전 확인: 설계와 적용 가능성 (2026-11-04 21:0x, 초안))

candidates.rule: During parallel probing, worker threads send only first messages and return results; tool actions, event recording, and outcome updates remain on the main thread, with shared situation state read by only that thread.
candidates.quote: 판단, 도구 호출, 기록은 모두 메인 스레드에 남는다.
candidates.harness: Keep state-changing actions and ordered records on the main thread; workers must not call tools or update outcomes.

candidates.rule: The proposed parallel search can cause up to K−1 shops per order to be contacted and then cancelled, but the design calls for no seller-side change.
candidates.quote: 우리 가게도 같은 일을 당하므로 seller 쪽은 바꿀 것이 없다.
candidates.harness: Do not add seller-specific behavior for this buyer change.

candidates.rule: The proposed shelf guard defaults to off and parallel probing defaults to K=1; enabling either is a strategy change that requires user approval and a new version.
candidates.quote: 기본값은 지금 동작.
candidates.harness: Keep both settings at their current-behavior defaults unless the user approves enabling them in a new version.

candidates.rule: Before deployment, test that a clearly insufficient C-claim receipt is rejected and the next shop can succeed, that parallel probing yields one result and cancels other conversations, that an unsolicited first-message receipt is not paid, and that K=1 preserves current event order.
candidates.quote: 단위 테스트(`tests/test_buyer_core.py`의 가짜 `Shop`, `connect=` 주입):
candidates.harness: Require these behavioral tests before deploying the redesigned buyer.

candidates.rule: Before live use, run a local A2A test with three fake shops delayed by 0, 3, and 9 seconds, execute the real buyer, and retain logs.
candidates.quote: 가짜 가게 3개(지연 0/3/9 s)를 띄우고 `market_buyer.py`를 실제로 실행, 로그를 `logs/local/`에 남긴다.
candidates.harness: Run and retain the specified local test before live rollout.

candidates.rule: The proposed live rollout is shelf guard alone for one hour, followed by parallel_probe=3 for one hour; turn the shelf guard off if food ledger successes fall compared with the preceding hour.
candidates.quote: 먼저 shelf guard만 1시간, 그다음 `parallel_probe = 3` 1시간.
candidates.harness: Roll out in those stages, compare hourly food ledger successes, and disable the shelf guard if they decline.

candidates.rule: The benefit of parallel probing remains to be determined after measuring v62 and the shelf guard; the design proposes deciding on parallel search only after those results are available.
candidates.quote: 효과는 v62와 설계 1을 측정한 뒤 판단한다.
candidates.harness: Do not enable parallel probing on the assumption that it improves results; evaluate it after the preceding measurements.

candidates.rule: The proposed measurement targets are food receipt payment rejection at 15% or less, food-order ledger success at 50% or more, median food-order time no slower than v62, and half as many timeout conversations as the baseline of 211.
candidates.quote: 식품 영수증 중 결제 거절 | 34% | 15% 이하
candidates.harness: Report these targets alongside the six-hour baselines when evaluating the changes.
